name: Free fall (measure g)
description: Motion-sensor log of a steel ball dropped from rest. Two linearisations both recover g ≈ 9.8 m/s²: regress velocity_y_ms vs time_s (slope = g), or compute t² = time_s × time_s and regress distance_m vs t² (slope = g/2, since distance = ½g·t²). Values carry small sensor scatter so the fit is realistic rather than perfect.

columns.name: velocity_y_ms
columns.description: Downward speed from the motion sensor, in m/s

columns.name: distance_m
columns.description: Distance fallen from the release point, in metres
